sentences.text:
Mr. I. Haque, learned counsel for the appellant has drawn attention of the Court to Section 96 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as per which, no income tax or stamp duty shall be levied on any award or agreement made under this Act, except under Section 46 and no person claiming under such award or agreement shall be liable to pay any fee for the copy of the same.
It is not in dispute that the award under question does not fall under Section 46 of the Act.
